name: ad-recon
title: AD Initial Recon
description: The opening evidence sweep for a domain-joined target: nmap discovery through anonymous AD enumeration. Each step runs through the same scope-enforced runner and parser as `obol run`.

steps.label: Fast TCP open-port discovery
steps.note: All TCP ports at a high rate; establishes the live host and open ports.

steps.label: Targeted service and default-script scan
steps.note: Fingerprints the discovered ports so AD service moves unlock. Runs after step 1 fills the port list.

steps.label: Identify the domain controller and domain
steps.note: NetExec LDAP smoke test: DC candidate, domain name, and base DN.

steps.label: Anonymous LDAP enumeration
steps.note: Unauthenticated bind for the domain user list.

steps.label: SMB / RID user enumeration
steps.note: Guest RID brute-force — the noisiest recon step; use when anonymous LDAP is thin.
